title: Manager at Fund Administration Firm Is Bullish on Intuit Growth as AI and Cloud Migration Drive Adoption
expert: Client service manager, fund administration firm (Gen II Fund Services), 50-100 HNW clients (current)
verdict: This fund administrator's QuickBooks client count rose about 50% (about 50 to 66-75) with per-client prices up 25%-33% and 80%-85% of clients holding or growing spend, driven by AI-led cloud migration.

Paid-customer and platform growth vs 13-: 🟢 **QuickBooks clients about 50 to 66-75 (+about 50%)**, Intuit activity +about 50% Aug-Oct; vs +5%-10% at a 55-client advisory firm (2026-11-08 call) and company +3% online paid customers (SB #48888): far above, small base. → Tenet 2 (core funnel) ↑ [14 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-268423&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse9379&hl=fse9379,fse9637,fse9689,fse9725&page=2)

🟢 **Pipeline was 25%-33% lower a year ago**; full-year 2026 activity +about 50% (estimate). → Tenet 2 (core funnel) ↑ [15 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-268423&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse13209&hl=fse13209,fse13442,fse13485,fse13575&page=2)
Pricing and ARPC (Tenet 2): 🟢 **Per-client prices +25%-33%, complex clients +66%-75%** (unclear whether Intuit list price or the firm's billing); vs 5%-10% and 1%-5% acceptable at two consultancies (2026-11-08 calls): **higher**. → Tenet 2 (pricing) ↑ [17 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-268423&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse19631&hl=fse19631,fse19823,fse19908&page=2)
Competition and retention (Tenet 5): 🟢 **80%-85% of clients maintained or increased business**; consistent with Intuit's stable 83% retention (SB #59455). → Tenet 5 (retention 82%+) ↑ [18 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-268423&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse20700&hl=fse20700,fse20971,fse21021,fse21263&page=2)

changes: QuickBooks clients +about 50% (first-hand) vs Intuit activity +5%-10% at a 55-client advisory firm (2026-11-08 call): much stronger.
Per-client prices +25%-33% vs 5%-10% (2026-11-08 consultancy) and 1%-5% acceptable (2026-11-08 advisory firm): conflicting; vs 2026-08-01 list increases of +13% to +24% (thesis page): higher.
80%-85% of clients holding or growing spend vs company retention stable at 83% (SB #59455): consistent.
thesis_impact: Tenet 2 (core funnel and pricing): ↑ — client count +about 50% and per-client prices +25%-33% in this channel.
Tenet 5 (disruption contained): ↑ — 80%-85% hold or grow spend; occasional downgrades from pricing and AI not quantified.
Tenet 1 (mid-market): → — complex clients pay +66%-75% more, but no IES-specific figure.
